+from __future__ import annotations

+MM = .22186
+SHEET_CX, SHEET_CY = -.1, 0.
+HALF = .227185 / 2
+PRACTICE_CX, PRACTICE_CY = -.1, -.1856
+
+def main_xy(u, v, z):
+    """Map target-image coordinates to world; calibration puts sheet centre at (-.1,0)."""
+    X, Y = (u + .5) * MM / 1000., (v + .5) * MM / 1000.
+    return np.array([SHEET_CX + HALF - Y, SHEET_CY + HALF - X, z])
+
+def get_robot():
+    r = Robot()
+    (OUT / "spec.json").write_text(json.dumps(r.spec(), indent=2))
+    return r
+
+def pose(p):
+    return np.r_[np.asarray(p, float), QDOWN]
+
+def linear_points(start, end, speed=.10, dt=.05):
+    a, b = np.asarray(start, float), np.asarray(end, float)
+    # Dense samples keep the target under the service's speed cap, including orientation.
+    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b[:3]-a[:3]) / (speed*dt))))
+    return np.array([pose(a[:3] + (b[:3]-a[:3])*(i/n)) for i in range(1,n+1)], np.float32)
+
+def move(r, xyz, zspeed=.10, cameras=None, label="move", save=True):
+    now = np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"], float)
+    start = now[7:10]
+    end = np.asarray(xyz, float)
+    a = linear_points(start, end, zspeed)
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", a, dt=.05, cameras=cameras, video="mp4", video_fps=8,
+                   note=label)
+    if save:
+        d = RUNS / f"{int(time.time())}_{label}"
+        res.save(str(d))
+        print(label, "plan", res.meta.get("plan"), "saved", d, flush=True)
+    return res
+
+def stay(r, xyz, seconds, cameras=None, label="hold", save=True):
+    n = max(1, round(seconds/.05))
+    a = np.repeat(pose(xyz)[None,:], n, axis=0).astype(np.float32)
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", a, dt=.05, cameras=cameras, video="mp4", video_fps=8,
+                   note=label)
+    if save:
+        d = RUNS / f"{int(time.time())}_{label}"
+        res.save(str(d))
+        print(label, "plan", res.meta.get("plan"), "saved", d, flush=True)
+    return res
+
+def observe(r, cams, label):
+    o = r.get_obs(cameras=cams, depth=True, video="none")
+    for c, im in o.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save(str(OUT / f"{label}_{c}.png"))
+    for c, d in o.last_depth.items(): np.save(OUT / f"{label}_{c}_depth.npy", d)
+    print(label, "time_left", o.meta.get("time_left_s"), "tip", o.meta["proprio"]["now"][7:10], flush=True)
